verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's own docs say users create team-scoped API keys for SDK and HTTP API access, so it issues credentials with team-level scoping. Nothing shows per-key permission scopes, least-privilege roles, or agent-specific credentials. The outbound credential-injection feature is a different capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: fine-grained permission scopes or roles on API keys, least-privilege or agent-specific key issuance, key expiry and revocation controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: create a team-scoped API key and export it as SANDBOX0_TOKEN
